selection: validation verified count, then expansions; model frozen before final
library_selection: first eight independently proved candidates from training-state order; no validation/final candidate mining
firewall: disjoint declared task families and exact alpha exclusion; related laws/compositions remain correlated; public authored data, not external or secret holdout
cost: fresh observation caches per evaluation task/policy; initial observations, search, final compilation, offline candidate discovery, repeated library compilation, training and independent replay separately recorded; report cold one-shot and amortized search costs
success_criterion: improved final verified solutions or fewer expansions at equal budget; no breakthrough claim without independent external replication
